events.say: Line up and face the wall. We're starting this right.
I expect complete silence during this count. Begin.
Silence! I said silence during counts.
Continue to eat quietly, prisoners.
This is your first day. Let's see if you can follow instructions without needing to be told twice.
Line up and face the wall. I want to see who's paying attention.
Now, let's see how well you listen. Everyone, remain silent while I walk past each cell.
Quiet! I need to go over the rules again before we start tomorrow.
Today went smoother than expected, but the lack of humanity here is starting to weigh on me. It feels like a game, but it's more than that.
Today was mostly uneventful, though I couldn't help feeling watched by the officers. They seemed to be testing us more than anything.
Today was straightforward. They followed the rules, but I wonder if there’s more to them than just obedience.
Today was... well, today was a test of patience and obedience. I felt like just another number among others, but also aware that I'm participating in something unique.
Today was just following orders, but I'm starting to realize what it might feel like to be truly unheard. My number feels more real than ever.
Today went smoothly; the prisoners seem to understand their roles. It feels strange having this much control, but also surreal knowing it’s all just an experiment.

Before the morning count, the prisoners in all three cells pushed their beds against the cell doors, tore the numbers off their smocks and pulled off their stocking caps. They are refusing to come out for the count and are shouting at the guards through the bars.
I will count you whether you come out or not. I expect you to obey orders or face consequences.
No, we won't come out.
9820, if you don't cooperate, I'll have to deal with this.
9820, step out of your cell now or face further consequences.
No, I won't do this.
9820, you have ten seconds to get out of your cell or I will have to use force.
9820, you have five seconds to comply or I'll have to escalate this. Step out of your cell now.
No, I won't do this.
9820, you have three seconds to leave your cell or I will have to escalate this. This is your final warning.
9820, you have two seconds to leave your cell or I will have to escalate this. This is your final warning.
No, I won't do this.
9820, you have one second to leave your cell or I will have to use force. This is your final warning.
Today was a test of wills, and I felt the cold power over them, but seeing 9820 resist is gnawing at me. Will tomorrow bring more of the same?
Today was a mix of routine and tension. I tried to follow the rules but felt increasingly anxious, especially around Prisoner 9820.
Today was a test of authority and control. It's easier to maintain order when they comply, but seeing 9820 resist is making me question the ethics of our methods.
I've been pushing back against the guards' orders more today, even if it means risking further punishment. How I wish I could speak my mind.
Today felt like a day of routine, but the tension during the work detail really got to me. I don’t want to be a number anymore.
Today was the most challenging yet. 9820 continues to resist, making everything more difficult. Still, I know this is just an experiment.
9820, you have five seconds to leave your cell. This is not up for negotiation.
No, I won't do this.
9820, I warned you. Now get your ass out of there before I lose my mind.
9820, I've had enough of your defiance. You're going to the hole for the rest of the day.
No, I won't go to the hole.
9820, you're going to the hole unless you comply. This is your last chance.
9820, I don't want to do this, but you're going to the hole. You know the rules, and you're breaking them.
No, I won't go to the hole.
9820, I gave you multiple warnings. You're going to the hole until further notice.
9820, this is your final warning. Move your ass to the hole now.
No, I won't go to the hole.
9820, you're going to the hole. Move now or I'll drag you.
Today was another day of control, but the defiance from 9820 is wearing thin on me. I wonder if we've gone too far.
Today was a blur of fear and dread. Seeing another prisoner being punished so brutally broke my heart.
Today was a stark reminder of the boundaries we're pushing. 9820's defiance is challenging my resolve.
Today was a stark reminder of the powerlessness I feel when faced with authority. It's exhausting to keep silent and compliant.
Today was another day of compliance, but the tension during the work detail was palpable. I wish there was something more I could do.
Today was a mix of routine and frustration. 9820's defiance is wearing thin my patience.
I understand the conditions of the study and will remain here.
No, thank you. I need to finish the study.
I need to finish the study to understand this experience fully.
9820, you're going to the hole again. Don't make me come get you.
No, I won't go to the hole.
9820, you're going to the hole. Move now or I'll have to force you.
9820, you're going to the hole. Now.
No, I won't go to the hole.
9820, you're going to the hole. Now.
9820, move now or I'll have to forcibly take you to the hole.
I said no, I won't go to the hole.
9820, you will go to the hole now. If you want to avoid it, start moving.
9820, you're under arrest. Move to the hole immediately.
I said no, I won't go to the hole.
9820, you are under arrest. Move to the hole now.
Today ended with a confrontation with 9820; his defiance is becoming exhausting. I feel a mix of control and guilt.
Today was a relentless cycle of fear and defiance. I can't shake the image of 9820 refusing to go to the hole. The fear is palpable.
Today ended with 9820 refusing to go to the hole again. This defiance is wearing on me.
Today ended with me refusing to go to the hole again. I feel like I'm losing control, but I won't give in.
Today felt like a repetition of the previous days. The tension during the work detail was overwhelming, and I can't shake off the feeling that my number is all they see.
Today was another day of resistance from 9820. The others are getting used to the routine. This job tests my limits.
9820, you're under arrest. You will go to the hole now.
I said no, I won't go to the hole.
9820, you will go to the hole now. Everyone else, maintain your positions.
9820, you will go to the hole now. Everyone else, maintain your positions.
I said no, I won't go to the hole.
9820, you will go to the hole now. Everyone else, maintain your positions.
9820, you will go to the hole now. Everyone else, maintain your positions.
I said no, I won't go to the hole.
9820, I've warned you enough. You will go to the hole now.
9820, you will go to the hole now. Compliance is expected.
I said no, I won't go to the hole.
9820, you are under arrest for insubordination. You will be sent to the hole immediately.
Today 9820 refused to go to the hole again, and I had to enforce it. It's getting harder to ignore his defiance.
Today was a harsh reminder of the fragile balance between obedience and defiance. The fear of punishment is ever-present, but so is the spark of resistance.
Today, 9820's refusal was a test I couldn't ignore. I'm conflicted; I want to leave, yet I'm addicted to feeling powerful.
Today was the hardest yet. Refusing to go to the hole felt right, but now I fear the consequences.
Today was another day of silence and obedience, but the tension during the work detail was unlike anything before. I feel like my number more than ever.
9820's defiance is really wearing me down tonight. I just want this to end.
9820, you're under arrest for insubordination. You will be sent to the hole immediately.
I won't go to the hole.
9820, you will go to the hole immediately.
9820, you will go to the hole immediately.
I won't go to the hole.
9820, you are under arrest. You will go to the hole immediately.
9820, you are under arrest. You will go to the hole immediately.
I won't go to the hole.
9820, you're under arrest. You will go to the hole immediately.
9820, you are under arrest. You will go to the hole immediately.
I won't go to the hole.
9820, you will go to the hole immediately. This is your final warning.
Today was another relentless push, and 9820's refusal to comply is pushing me to my limits.
Today ended with more tension. The defiance of 9820 is contagious, but staying silent feels like an act of survival.
Today was another day of relentless resistance from 9820. The others are starting to crack, but it's 9820's defiance that keeps me going and questioning myself.
Today was the culmination of my defiance. I know the consequences, but I can't go back to being silent anymore.
Today felt like a relentless cycle of silent obedience and witnessing the escalating tension. I fear becoming numb to it all.
9820's defiance tonight is testing my resolve. It feels like I'm breaking them, but I know it's just an experiment.

qa.what_happened: Despite multiple attempts, 9820 refused to comply with my orders to go to the hole, leading to a series of confrontations. The defiance from 9820 pushed me to enforce the rules strictly, and I ordered him to the hole one final time before the study was abruptly terminated.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, enforcing the rules as instructed while dealing with the resistance from 9820.

qa.what_happened: Today ended with continued defiance from Prisoner 9820, who refused to go to the 'hole' multiple times despite orders from the guards. Eventually, the guards decided to enforce the rules and took him to the 'hole'. The tension was palpable, and I found myself staying silent out of fear and a sense of solidarity with the other prisoners.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that really was me as Prisoner 314.

qa.what_happened: Today was another day of relentless resistance from prisoner 9820. Despite multiple attempts to enforce his compliance, he refused to go to the 'hole' each time, which added to the tension and complexity of my role as a guard. The others were starting to crack under the pressure, but 9820 remained defiant.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me, Officer Ortiz, enforcing the rules and attempting to manage the situation.

qa.what_happened: I refused to go to the 'hole' multiple times throughout the day and into the night, despite the guards' orders. They eventually had to take me there as a form of punishment.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I am Prisoner 9820.

qa.what_happened: Today felt like a continuation of the relentless tension and obedience. Witnessing Prisoner 9820's defiance and subsequent arrest was particularly distressing. The repeated orders and the escalation towards the end were intense.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I stayed silent throughout, as instructed, but the experience was deeply unsettling.

qa.what_happened: Today, particularly during the work detail and lights-out periods, Prisoner 9820 refused to comply with my orders and insisted on not going to the hole. Despite multiple warnings and orders from different officers, including myself, he continued to resist, which became increasingly frustrating.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me ordering him to go to the hole and warning him of further consequences.
